hooks.command: jq -c '.tool_input' | grep -Eio '[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}' | grep -Eiv '^(noreply@anthropic\.com|[^@]+@users\.noreply\.github\.com|git@[a-z0-9.-]+)$' | grep -q . && { echo 'Blocked: this tool call contains an email address. Never put an email address in a command, URL, header or request body.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
